description: Checks both halves (secp256k1 + ML-DSA-65) of a NULLSIG1 over a document hash. Pass signerMldsaPub (from the signer's published record) to also require the PQ key blessing (bind2) - without it a quantum forger of the classical half could pass. ts is signer-claimed; use NULL Notary for proof of time.
name: null_sign_verify
title: NULL Sign - verify a NULLSIG1 document signature
